newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady, wary of crude rise.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil steady, wary of crude rise.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices remained stable on Thursday with buyers pushed onto the sidelines by uncertainty over the lasting strength of the rise in crude, traders said.
Very little business was seen done. Market players said a cargo of low sulphur straight-run sold on Tuesday from Ireland had gone for $106.50, slightly under notional offer prices of $107 and $108.
Some sellers said they were watching the rise in Brent futures to see if it would hold, but acknowledged that a healthy flow of supplies in Europe and the Med would undercut any price appreciation.
Russian material has reappeared at Baltic ports, with buyers picking up cargoes on Wednesday and more still on offer at three means +$4, traders said.
